svg.title: Four posteriors from four priors on the same 26 of 40 seed data
svg.desc: Four beta density curves over germination rates, all fitted to the same data under different priors, with the posterior probability above one half labelled for each.
svg.text: Same data, four defensible priors, four conclusions
Twenty-six of forty seeds germinated in every one of these four fits.
The skeptical prior is worth twenty observations pointed the other way. It moves the posterior mean from 0.6364 to exactly 0.5000 and the probability above one half from 0.9670 to exactly 0.5000.
A report that shows only one of these four curves has hidden a choice, not settled one.
